_help: Copy to config.json (git-ignored, since it holds your email) and fill in. Every key is optional; these are the defaults except alert_email and github_repo.
_create_github_oidc_provider: Set to false if your AWS account already has GitHub's OIDC provider.
_data_sources: Priority order. ESPN needs no key; API-NBA is used only after `make set-api-key`.
_domain: Optional custom domain (about $0.50/month for the hosted zone). Needs aws_region us-east-1.
